stable.message: No stable release yet. Please use beta or dev.

beta.name: rasqberry-beta-2026-11-15
highlights: Wi-Fi hotspot for booths and classrooms: phones and laptops join the Pi's own network with a QR code and find its demos on a landing page
A new Pi without a network opens a setup hotspot, so you can reach it and connect it to your Wi-Fi, also without a screen
Without a password from Imager, SSH accepts the published password only for 15 minutes after a start and asks for a new one; VNC comes on after that
Bluetooth speakers: calibrate the sound delay until the tick and the LED flash come together
Qiskit 2.6, the IBM Quantum Learning paths, and Ket, the AI helper, on the Pi's start page
Many fixes from user tests: window sizes, names and bookmarks, LED demos in a sandbox, VNC kept after an update, Wi-Fi names with accents
